figures.alt: A fluffy giant panda cub rests its tilted head against a tree fork and hugs the branch. Beside it, purple and orange ochre sea stars with thick, textured arms cling to wet intertidal rocks among mussels and algae. Both scenes receive equal visual space; the illustration provides no evidence about their relative conservation value.
